name: Arix Energix Limited
summary: Arix Energix Limited operates as a web-infomedia company in India. The company operates through four segments: Web based Solution/Software Development; MagaZine /Info Media; Exhibition Management; and Investments/Treasury. It operates JimTrade.com, a business-to-business (B2B) directory of product profiles listed under various product categories; and JimYellowpages.com, a business yellow-page of listed Indian SMEs facilitating business transaction with complete contact details. The company also offers IndiaNetzone.com, an encyclopedia of India with articles providing information on arts, entertainment, health, sports, society, travel, and other areas related to India. The company was formerly known as Jupiter Infomedia Limited and change its name to Arix Energix Limited in July 2026. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Ahmedabad, India. Arix Energix Limited operates as a subsidiary of Arix Capital Limited.
